{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Identify the QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']

# Check how many QA orders there are
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Confirm they are all completed (as per documentation)
print(f"Status of QA orders: {qa_orders['status'].unique()}")

# Remove QA orders from the dataset
actual_completed = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != '999999.99')]

# Count actual completed orders
actual_completed_count = len(actual_completed)
print(f"Number of actual completed orders (excluding QA): {actual_completed_count}")"}
